note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide is written for this entry, in its own words, and names its sources. Hidden marks the trophies PlayStation hides until earned; missable marks the ones tied to a single story moment — make a manual save before that mission.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, missables before their missions pass, then side content, collectibles and money. Keep one manual save slot for the endgame so the 100% clean-up never needs a second playthrough.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum pops automatically with the last one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this trophy is unmissable: play the story from the start and it pops when the mission ends. The trailers open on Lucia leaving prison and reuniting with Jason in Leonida, and the first jobs set up the duo's partnership. No preparation is needed — just follow the on-screen objectives.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish its objectives to complete the mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 1. The chapter introduces Leonida's map — Vice City, the Keys, Port Gellhorn and the Grassrivers — and the crew around Lucia and Jason. Chapter trophies are pure story progress: they cannot be missed, and a chapter's final mission is marked in the pause menu's mission list. If you are hunting missables, do them before each chapter's missions, not after.
steps: Play through Chapter 1's story missions in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 2. The chapter's name says what the work is: the duo's scores get bigger and the jobs move from small-time robberies toward the cartel work the later mission trophies name. Nothing here is missable on its own, but the mission-specific trophies in this stretch are — check the missable flags before starting VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory.
steps: Play through Chapter 2's story missions in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 3. By this point the story is centred on Vice City itself — the Ocean Beach strip, the downtown towers and the port — and the missions start chaining into the heists the gold trophies reward. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: it is the cheapest insurance if a missable in this stretch goes wrong.
steps: Play through Chapter 3's story missions in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. The endgame missions are where the remaining story trophies cluster, so before the final mission, sweep the missable flags and the stranger strands — after the finale, free roam continues, but one-time story moments do not come back. Chapter 4's completion is the signal to start the clean-up stages of the roadmap.
steps: Play through Chapter 4's story missions in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission, then start roadmap stage 2.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is gold, and it is the gate to the post-game: once it is done, free roam stays open for the collectibles, counts and money trophies. Before you start it, make a manual save — the finale is also the last chance to catch any missable tied to the endgame missions, and a save here lets you replay the finale without replaying the chapter.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is one of the early duo missions — Lucia and Jason running a job together — and it pops when the mission's objectives are done. Mission trophies are story progress, so they cannot be missed; if a mission fails, replay it from the checkpoint and the trophy still counts.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete the mission's objectives.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. The trailers show the duo hitting bigger targets as the story escalates, and this heist is one of the set-piece jobs — expect a planned approach, a getaway, and a wanted level to lose on the way out. Finish the mission and the trophy pops; there is no extra objective hidden in it.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete the heist and escape.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The name points at the family thread running through Lucia's story — the people she came home to — so expect the mission to mix a personal scene with the job itself. Like every mission trophy, it is story progress and cannot be missed.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Complete the mission's objectives.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The title is the duo's arc in one word: Lucia and Jason going from nobodies to the names on everyone's lips in Leonida, with the press and the police both watching. Finish the mission's objectives and the trophy pops — no side objective is attached to it.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown — and treat it as missable, because the takedown itself is a one-time story set-piece at the airport. Make a manual save before starting the mission, then play it through: the trophy pops on completion. If anything about the takedown feels like a one-shot stunt (a hijack, a runway move), do it inside this mission — the airport does not replay it afterwards.
steps: Make a manual save before VCIA Takedown.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory — and make a manual save first, because a military operation is a one-time story event that free roam never repeats. The mission's name suggests heavy hardware and a big set-piece; play it through to the end and the trophy pops on completion. Any stunt or takedown the mission offers happens only here, so do not rush past the optional beats.
steps: Make a manual save before Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, every stranger strand, every collectible set, every activity the checklist tracks and every stunt, race and challenge the game counts. The in-game stats page shows the percentage and what is left — use it as the clean-up list, not memory. This is a late-game trophy by design: it pops in the final clean-up stage, usually just before the platinum.
steps: Finish the story and all side content.
Check the stats page for the remaining percentage.
Clear the last items until it reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime, drifts and anything the game scores as a stunt. They accumulate across the whole playthrough, so most players are well past 100 by the finale without trying. To finish the count fast afterwards, chain stunt jumps off the airport ramps and the Vice City causeways in a fast car, and watch the counter in the stats page.
steps: Play normally — stunts count from the first mission.
After the story, farm stunt jumps at the airport and causeways.
Check the stats page until the count reads 250.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, street racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the WAiNK street game. One attempt each is enough — no win is required. The fastest route is a tour of Vice City in one session: the range, an arcade, the bowling alley, a fishing spot and a meditation spot are all in or near the city.
steps: Try fishing, the shooting range and a drone race.
Try a street race, an arcade game and bowling.
Try meditation, hunting and WAiNK once each.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are several ranges across Leonida, each with its own set of timed and accuracy drills; gold needs both speed and precision, so learn one range's drills before moving on. Use the weapon the drill asks for, aim for headshots where the scoring rewards them, and replay a drill immediately — scores save per drill, so a gold on one never blocks another.
steps: Visit every shooting range in Leonida.
Play each challenge until it medals gold.
Replay any drill that medals below gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own course — beachfront, downtown rooftops, the port, the Keys — and the win counts per location, so one win each is enough. Drones handle differently from cars: brake early for the gates, cut the corners the course allows, and use the boost pads on the straights. The map marks each race once you have found it.
steps: Find all 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win one race at each location.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street races, off-road, boat and bike events all count as long as each race is a different one. The race markers appear across Leonida once the story opens the map up; winning needs a vehicle matched to the event, so keep a fast street car, an off-roader and a boat ready. Repeat wins of the same race do not count toward the 20.
steps: Unlock race markers across Leonida.
Win 20 different races in any mix of types.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal Hampton in a fishing challenge. Cal is the duo's friend from the trailers — the fishing regular who knows Leonida's waters — and the challenge is a head-to-head catch: bigger or more fish than Cal in the time given. Use the best rod and bait the spot offers, watch the line tension so it never snaps, and reel steadily instead of yanking. The challenge is repeatable, so a lost round costs nothing but time.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Out-fish Cal before the time runs out.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full run of any cabinet in any arcade in Leonida. The arcades are scattered through Vice City's malls and boardwalk; pick a cabinet, pay the small fee and play to the end of its run. No high score is required, only a completion, so choose the shortest game on the row if you just want the trophy.
steps: Find an arcade in Vice City.
Play any cabinet to the end of its run.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy is one of the story's supporting contacts, and his strand ends with a last job that closes his arc — the trophy pops when that mission completes. Contact finales unlock as their strands progress through the story, so keep taking Andy's calls and jobs when they appear rather than leaving them for the endgame.
steps: Play Andy's mission strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton's strand runs through Leonida's waters — boats, the Keys and the smuggling routes the trailers show — and his last job is the payoff for the whole strand. As with every contact finale, the mission appears as the strand progresses, so answer his jobs when they come up.
steps: Play Kenton's mission strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is the biker thread of the story — the lone-rider jobs on Leonida's highways — and the finale closes it. Keep a fast bike handy for his jobs, and take them as they appear so the strand does not sit unfinished into the endgame.
steps: Play Billy's mission strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map — odd characters with their own multi-mission stories, from the Keys to Mount Kalaga. A strand counts when its last mission ends, so a half-finished stranger does not count. There are more than 8 strands in the state, so pick the ones nearest your route and finish them fully.
steps: Follow stranger markers across Leonida.
Complete 8 full strands, last mission included.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy's strand is the supply side of Leonida's underworld — moving product between the port, the Keys and the city — and his last job closes it. Take his jobs as they appear through the story so the finale unlocks on schedule.
steps: Play Randy's mission strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand runs through Vice City's music and club scene — the trailers show the city's nightlife front and centre — and his last job is its finale. Keep playing his strand whenever it appears and the finale will unlock in turn.
steps: Play Tyrone's mission strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The spots sit at viewpoints and quiet corners — beaches, the Keys, hilltops above Vice City — and each one is a short sit-down, not a challenge. The map does not mark them until you are near, so sweep the coastline and the high places in free roam; this guide's checklist tracks the count as you go.
steps: Find meditation spots at viewpoints across Leonida.
Sit and meditate at all 18.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a stranger strand in the wilds — the Grassrivers and the swamps north of the city — and the target is one specific animal, not any animal. Track it with the hunting prompts, take the shot cleanly, and bring the proof back to Bret. The animal only appears for this hunt, so follow Bret's strand rather than wandering the swamps at random.
steps: Start Bret's hunting strand.
Track and take down the unique animal.
Return to Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. The cards are hidden across Leonida — shops, houses, the beachfront, the Keys — and each set is a group of cards that belongs together. A set counts only when every card in it is found, so collect by set rather than at random: finish one set's locations before starting the next, and use this guide's checklist to mark each card as you find it.
steps: Find cards across Leonida, set by set.
Complete 3 full sets.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-world street game — tag the marked spots across Vice City and the rest of Leonida — and each location counts once. The spots cluster in the city, so a walking sweep of downtown, Ocean Beach and the boardwalk clears most of them; the rest sit at landmarks out in the state. The counter in the stats page shows how many remain.
steps: Find WAiNK spots across Leonida.
Tag 100 different locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — driving, shooting, flying, exploration and more — and they tick over naturally through a full playthrough. After the story, open the challenges list in the pause menu, sort by nearest to done, and clear the almost-finished ones first; 50 is well short of the full list, so there is no need to chase the hardest ones.
steps: Play the story and side content — challenges complete as you go.
After the story, clear the nearest-to-done challenges to 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape. This is missable in practice because it needs your partner present — and partner free roam is tied to the story's duo missions, not always available. Do it during a story stretch where Lucia and Jason are together: build the wanted level to 4 stars away from the mission objective, then break line of sight and hide until it clears, with your partner still with you.
steps: Wait for a story stretch with your partner beside you.
Reach a 4-star wanted level together.
Escape and lose the heat with your partner present.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — the chain breaks if the heat drops between shops. Like Hot Together, it needs your partner present, so do it during a duo stretch of the story. Pick three shops close together on the same street, rob them one after another without stopping, and keep moving: the wanted level must stay live across all three.
steps: Wait for a story stretch with your partner beside you.
Pick 3 shops close together.
Rob all 3 in a row without losing the wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — sit in or drive 100 different models across Leonida. The count covers cars, bikes, boats, aircraft and anything else with an engine, and it grows fastest by driving everything you pass instead of sticking to one car. Car parks, the port, the airport and the Keys' boat docks are the richest hunting grounds; the stats page shows the count.
steps: Drive every different vehicle you pass.
Sweep car parks, the port, the airport and the docks.
Keep going until the count reads 100.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode the trailers show in shootouts — trigger it when a group is clustered, then drop five before it ends. The easiest setup is a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff in a tight street: let the enemies group up first, then activate it and work across them. It is repeatable, so a 4-down attempt costs nothing.
steps: Find a fight with 5 or more enemies grouped up.
Trigger Combat Focus and down 5 before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. This is a one-time story moment: the airport sequence in the VCIA missions is the only scripted chance to leave the airport in a way the game did not schedule. Make a manual save before the airport missions, and when the mission gives you an aircraft or a runway, take off on your own terms instead of following the flight plan.
steps: Make a manual save before the VCIA missions.
During the airport sequence, depart in an unscheduled aircraft.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is the military tank, and the trophy's joke is the heat inside one — the task is to fight in a Rhino. Steal one from the military base or take one during a story mission that fields them, then use it in combat: the trophy is about the tank, not the mission, so any Rhino combat counts. Expect a heavy wanted response the moment you roll out in one.
steps: Get a Rhino tank — base theft or a story mission.
Fight in it until the trophy pops.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The clean run needs planning: case the store first, go in quiet — masked, no alarm tripped, no camera spotting you — take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so leave and try again; jewelry stores can be robbed repeatedly, so there is no penalty for a blown attempt beyond the time.
steps: Case a jewelry store in Vice City.
Rob it masked, without tripping an alarm or being spotted.
Leave clean — if detected, leave and retry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Banks are the big scores of Leonida: crack the vault, grab the take and lose the wanted level after each one — the escape counts as much as the robbery. Plan the getaway before going in, keep a fast car parked nearby, and do the five across different banks rather than hitting the same one twice.
steps: Find a bank with a vault.
Crack it, take the money and escape.
Repeat at 4 more banks.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The trucks run set routes through Vice City and the highways — the classic Blitz Play is to block one, crack its rear doors and take the cash before the escort reacts. Sticky bombs or a heavy vehicle stop the truck fastest; then grab the money and lose the wanted level. Trucks keep spawning, so a failed attempt just means waiting for the next one.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it, crack it and take the cash.
Escape and lose the wanted level.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every named district and region, from Ocean Beach and downtown Vice City to the Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga and the Grassrivers. An area counts when you enter it, so a road trip around the state map clears most of them; the last few are the small islands and the far corners. The stats page tracks the count, and the in-game map shades visited ground.
steps: Drive the full map: city, Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Kalaga.
Sweep the islands and far corners.
Check the stats page until all 52 are found.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang in Leonida runs its own rackets — stash houses, labs, docks — and each one is marked once you find it. Hit one operation per gang: the gang's name is shown on the operation, so work down the list of nine and mark each gang off as its operation is robbed. Expect armed resistance at every one.
steps: Find the gangs' illegal operations across Leonida.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The beachfront bars along Ocean Drive serve drinks with the ocean in front of you — sit down, order the cocktail and let the scene play. It is a quiet moment, not a challenge: the trophy is the game's nod to the opening hours, so do it early, when Vice City still feels new, and the view is the point.
steps: Go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach.
Order and enjoy a cocktail with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a one-time story moment — the showroom escape happens inside a mission, and free roam showrooms do not replay it. Make a manual save before the showroom mission, and when the moment comes, drive straight out through the glass in the mission's vehicle instead of taking the door. The trophy pops on the escape.
steps: Make a manual save before the showroom mission.
During the mission, smash out through the showroom glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — play a full game of bowling there. The alley is in Vice City; rent a lane, bowl your frames and finish the game. No score is required, only the follow-through of a complete game, so take your time with the shots and enjoy the alley's atmosphere.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling to the end.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the trophy is about Lucia and Jason as a duo, and it pops when a shared moment lands with the public. The trailers show the pair becoming Vice City's most talked-about couple, so this one is tied to a story beat where their partnership makes the news. Play the story and it comes on its own; there is no separate task to chase.
steps: Play the story's duo missions.
The trophy pops at the partnership story beat.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made — for better or worse — with PlayStation tracking a count to 500. The game is full of small choices: dialogue picks, approach decisions, who to help and who to leave. The count climbs across the whole playthrough, so there is no single moment to aim for: just keep choosing, in missions and in free roam, and the counter in the stats page shows the running total.
steps: Keep making choices in missions and free roam.
Check the stats page until the count reaches 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — this one is about failing once, then succeeding on the retry, in a single scripted moment. It is flagged missable because the moment is a specific story attempt: if the first try succeeds, the second-try moment never happens. Make a manual save before story attempts that look retryable, and if an attempt fails, do not reload — retry it in place and succeed the second time.
steps: Make a manual save before a retryable story attempt.
If the first try fails, retry it in place and succeed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the trophy for witnessing something strange in Leonida. The state hides odd sights: unexplained lights, strange figures, things that do not belong. Roam the far corners — the swamps at night, the Keys, the mountain roads — and the moment finds you. It is a wandering trophy, not a checklist one, so give it a few night drives in the empty places.
steps: Roam Leonida's far corners, especially at night.
Witness the strange event when it appears.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing the melee weapon as you pass, and the target goes down like a pin. Any slow vehicle works; a bike or a slow car gives the best control. It is repeatable, so a miss just means circling back for another pass.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a slow vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian and land the melee hit.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from the big scores — heists and vault robberies pay partly in marked cash that shops will not take. Launder them through your contacts, a cut at a time, and the clean money counts toward the $250,000. It accumulates across the whole game, so keep laundering after every big job rather than sitting on marked bills.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from heists and vaults.
Launder them through contacts.
Keep going until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, car mods, food and anything else with a price tag. The total counts every dollar spent in any shop, so it climbs on its own if you keep your loadout and wardrobe current. To finish it fast, spend the endgame fortune on the expensive items: high-end cars, full weapon kits and the priciest clothes in Vice City.
steps: Shop normally through the story.
After the story, spend the surplus on cars, weapons and clothes.
Stop when the total passes $100,000.
sources: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought through the in-game property market — they appear for sale as the story opens up new areas — and each one stores vehicles as well as counting toward this trophy. They are not cheap, so save the purchases for the endgame when the heist money is in; buy all eight and the trophy pops with the last deed.
steps: Open the property market as new areas unlock.
Buy each garage property when it is listed.
Own all 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is the delivery app of Leonida — the trailers show its riders everywhere — and registering a vehicle ties it to the app so it can be called up for deliveries. Drive ten different vehicles, open the app for each one and register it; any ten models count, so use the cars and bikes already in your garages.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app with a vehicle.
Register the vehicle.
Repeat with 9 more vehicles.
